title: Clean exit at a prepared seam
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, let $x$, $s$, and $y$ be Boolean words, let $q$ be a state of $B$, and let $q'$ be any optional state of the clean wrapper of $B$. The administrative configuration based on the seam with $s$ on tape zero, retained word $y$, control $q'$, input head at position $1$, capture head at position $0$, and empty output equals the two-ended configuration with control $q'$, tape zero containing $s$, the last tape containing $y$, both endpoint heads at position $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$q'$ is an optional state of the clean wrapper of $B$
replaced:
For a machine $B$ with at least one work tape: the clean wrapper's completed
administrative configuration over the prepared seam carrying $s$, with retained
output $y$, equals the two-ended configuration with tape zero $s$, capture tape
$y$, and both endpoint heads at zero.
